typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	datalakesnowuserimporttbl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		U_ELID as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		EMPLOYEE_NUMBER as string,
		NAME as string,
		WF_GUID as string,
		TIME_ZONE as string,
		TITLE as string,
		USER_NAME as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ORACLEDataSource
ORACLEDataSource derive(importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TIME_ZONE as string,
		WF_GUID as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EMPLOYEE_NUMBER as string,
		TITLE as string,
		U_ELID as string,
		USER_NAME as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TIME_ZONE,
		WF_GUID,
		importdate,
		EMPLOYEE_NUMBER,
		TITLE,
		U_ELID,
		USER_NAME,
		EMAIL,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($datalakesnowuserimporttbl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> datalakesnowuserimporttbl
